title: Observability: DO_KDF FIPS gate failure log omits provider name
description: When CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_DO_KDF's FIPS gate check fails (crypto2dev_fd.c ~line 2044), the log message includes algo and out_algo but not the provider name. In a multi-provider deployment, a support engineer cannot determine from the ring buffer which provider's gate is failing without attaching a debugger. Fix: include provider name in the pr_err at the gate-failed branch for DO_KDF, consistent with the FIPS gate failure messages in ioctl_init.
